hazards.name: Parking Garage Entrance
hazards.description: A large, multi-lane entrance to a parking garage crosses the sidewalk on the right, creating a high-conflict zone between pedestrians and turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Access Points
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the garage entrance to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting or furniture zone to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Mid-block Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to narrow the roadway and shorten the crossing distance while preventing illegal parking that blocks sightlines.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a line of street trees or a landscaped buffer between the curb and the walking area to protect pedestrians from traffic and improve the microclimate.

interventions.title: Street Furniture and Activation
interventions.description: Install benches, waste bins, or public art to utilize the excessive sidewalk width and create a more inviting pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters along the curb to provide a vertical buffer between pedestrians and traffic and improve the streetscape.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions or Parklets
interventions.description: If parking is permitted, use curb extensions to narrow the perceived roadway and provide more space for pedestrian amenities.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Convert a portion of the roadway into protected bike lanes to narrow the travel lanes and provide additional separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: If the block is long, install a high-visibility mid-block crossing with a pedestrian refuge or curb extensions.

interventions.title: Install Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add street trees, planters, or a furniture zone to separate pedestrians from the roadway.

interventions.title: Garage Exit Warning System
interventions.description: Install visual or audible warnings for pedestrians when a vehicle is exiting the garage.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Conflict Markings
interventions.description: Use contrasting pavement colors or textures at the garage entrance to alert drivers to the presence of the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Designated Loading Zones
interventions.description: Implement dedicated inset loading zones or off-street loading to prevent large vehicles from obstructing sightlines in the travel way.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Driveways
interventions.description: Restrict parking immediately adjacent to the garage entrance to ensure clear sightlines between exiting drivers and pedestrians on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Dedicated Bike Parking
interventions.description: Install formal bike racks to prevent bicycles from obstructing the narrow sidewalk on the right.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the travel lanes.

interventions.title: Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point.

interventions.title: Bollards
interventions.description: Install bollards along the curb line to prevent vehicles from accidentally or intentionally driving onto the wide sidewalk.

interventions.title: Continuous Raised Sidewalk
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk level and material across the garage driveway to clearly signal pedestrian priority and slow exiting vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Warning Signage and Lighting
interventions.description: Install visual and/or auditory warnings at the garage exit to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the garage entrance and exit to the minimum necessary to shorten the pedestrian exposure time in the conflict zone.

interventions.title: Designated Loading Zone
interventions.description: Implement a dedicated curb-side loading zone to prevent delivery vehicles from obstructing sidewalks or travel lanes.

interventions.title: Clear Pedestrian Through-Zone
interventions.description: Relocate temporary construction signage to the curb edge or furniture zone to ensure a continuous, unobstructed path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Enhanced Driveway Treatment
interventions.description: Use high-visibility paving materials and clear signage at the garage entrance to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If the block is long, install a marked mid-block crossing with a refuge island to facilitate safe pedestrian movement across the street.

interventions.title: Raised Driveway Crossing
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk level and material across the driveway to signal pedestrian priority and slow entering/exiting vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Install a furniture zone with trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand exists, install a marked mid-block crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to reduce the unprotected crossing distance of the wide road.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting fixtures designed for the sidewalk to improve visibility and safety during evening hours.

interventions.title: Dedicated Loading Zone
interventions.description: Designate specific curb space for commercial loading to prevent sidewalk blockages.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Install street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Install Bollards or Planters
interventions.description: Place permanent bollards or heavy planters along the curb to prevent vehicles from parking on the sidewalk and provide a physical buffer.
